name: @wise-evidence/discovery
description: Provider-neutral automated-research-discovery foundation for WiseEvidence (M7.1): the DiscoveryProvider contract, SourceDescriptor, typed discovery objects and errors, a source/provider registry seam, and a deterministic offline MockDiscoveryProvider. Discovery may discover/fetch/normalize/queue candidates only — it never publishes, classifies, or writes canonical research. No Astro, React, Supabase, web UI, or AI imports; DOI/title canonicalisation is reused from @wise-evidence/domain.
